test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following care and maintenance of a marking table is INCORRECT?

options.text: The marking table should be protected from rust.
The marking table should be protected from damage.
After use, the marking table should be cleaned with a soft cloth.
The surface of the marking table should not be given a thin layer of oil.

solution:
The correct answer is __The surface of the marking table should not be given a thin layer of oil.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The marking table__ should be maintained to ensure accuracy and longevity.
 
• Protection from rust is essential to avoid surface degradation.
 
• Cleaning with a soft cloth after use prevents dirt and residue buildup.
 
• Applying a thin layer of oil to the surface is a recommended practice to prevent rust and ensure smooth operation.
 
• Damage prevention ensures the marking table remains precise and functional.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Proper Care:**

 
 
• Regular maintenance and cleaning extend the lifespan of the marking table.
 
• Avoid using abrasive materials that could scratch or damage the surface.
 
 
 
• **Rust Prevention:**
 
 
• Keep the table in a dry environment to minimize exposure to moisture.
 
• Applying oil or anti-rust solutions helps maintain the metal surface.
 
 
 
• **Damage Prevention:**
 
 
• Avoid placing heavy or sharp objects on the table unnecessarily.
 
• Store the table in a secure location when not in use.
